extraction_notes: Transfer, output, and capacitance curve families are present and usable in Figures 3, 5, and 9; points are direct figure reads and no model fitting was performed.
The capacitance plot uses a logarithmic capacitance axis; plotted pF readings were converted to F for the schema.
The strict schema has one resistance value per RDS(on) point, so the published typical and maximum values for each VGS/ID pair are retained as separate entries.
The datasheet publishes additional gate-charge, switching, body-diode reverse-recovery, thermal, SOA, and temperature-variation data that have no corresponding fields in the strict extraction schema.

The supplied datasheet identifies the source manufacturer as All Power Semiconductor Co.,Ltd; the extraction identity field uses the immutable catalog manufacturer string ALLPOWER ShenZhen Quan Li Semiconductor for exact catalog cross-checking.
